Emerald Whelps are a unit of the family in Warcraft Rumble. They are virtually identical to the Whelp Eggs mini, though with some slight differences. They apply the poisonous effect, do not hatch out of eggs (meaning they are instantly able to attack) and are 1 gold cheaper. They are not normally collectable, instead being added to the player's tray when playing Ysera the Dreamer as their hero. A squad of whelps is made up of three members.

The Empire's Edge Tavern is a tavern located at the center of Mereldar in Hallowfall. The bar is tended by Nalina Ironsong, and a variety of Arathi craftsmen and off-duty soldiers are the majority of the clientele. The tavern, ironically across the street from the town's orphanage, sells a range of foods and beverages, many of them themed around the Arathi's cultural and religious devotion to the Light. The second floor of the building also functions as an inn, with several bunkbeds available for weary travelers, so long as they don't mind the shenanigans of inebriated patrons like Blimore and Soran Vidala at the dining area nearby.
